newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil oil firms started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil oil firms started.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian state oil firm Petrobras with an underperform rating.
-- also said had begun coverage of BR Distribuidora, Petrobras' retailing and distribution arm, with a market perform rating, and Petroleo Ipiranga with a market perform rating.

-- Analysts Jay Bhutani, Phokion Potamianos and Caroline Evascu said in a report the recommendation on Petrobras was based on the company's expensive valuation and the much higher level of financial and regulatory risks now associated with the firm.

-- They noted "the many positives associated with Petrobras -- strong oil production and cash flow growth, global leadership in deep sea drilling technology, and dominance of the Brazilian refining sector -- remain very much in place."

-- "Unfortunately, there is no way all these positives and the company's higher risk profile add up to 310 reais. Petrobras was once the cheapest stock in our universe and is now the priciest," they said.

-- Regarding BR Distribuidora, they said they believe the poor fundamentals of Brazilian retail operations are unlikely to improve. "BR will face declining margins due to excessive government influence in its operations and increased competition," the analysts said.
-- Concerning Petroleo Ipiranga, they said they believe "the company is fairly valued, and, while highly profitable, faces the quandary of how to expand its operations without diluting earnings."
-- Ipiranga must decide what kind of company it wants to be as it faces increased options in the changing regulatory environment of the Brazilian oil industry.
-- Petrobras preferred was off 1.59 percent at 310 reais.
-- BR Distribuidora was off 1.43 percent at 27.60 reais.
-- No trades were seen in Petroleo Ipiranga preferred stock.
